description: Source code for the vcnl4040 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for reading/writing sensor registers, data fetching, configuration, and initialization.

methods.name: vcnl4040_read
methods.description: Reads data from a specified register of the VCNL4040 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: vcnl4040_write
methods.description: Writes data to a specified register of the VCNL4040 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: vcnl4040_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches proximity and ambient light data from the sensor.

methods.name: vcnl4040_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves sensor data (proximity or light) for application use.

methods.name: vcnl4040_init
methods.description: Initializes the VCNL4040 sensor device, including device ID check and register setup.
